other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Case study is a water treatment plant with continuously metered raw-water/distribution flow and daily plant energy consumption — a 24/7 continuous-flow water utility context outside the eight registered sectors
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
Mahasawat water treatment plant located in Nontaburi province, Thailand is chosen for 
investigation the baseline. The energy consumption data of the plant equipment and facilities is measured from local 
recordable power meters and complied into a daily report.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Flow-based process variables (raw water flow, distribution and transmission flow) drive plant energy consumption modeling, indicating continuous throughput process
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
For MLP approach, we use DRF (Daily raw water flow) as the independent variable to 
predict DPEC and DDTF as shown in Fig.1.

one_line: The paper builds and validates an energy baseline model (MLP vs. linear regression) using multi-year daily energy and flow data from a municipal water treatment plant in Thailand, none of which falls in the eight registered Corpus-B continuous-process sectors.
